# Recommended Implementation Approach

**Create a working copy of the source files and perform all modifications on this isolated copy, maintaining a complete audit trail of all changes.** This satisfies the non-modification constraint [ctx_0001] while enabling the clean and auditable process the user requires [ctx_view_0002]. Document each transformation step with timestamps and change logs to ensure full traceability and the ability to revert to the original state if needed.
